objective: Rank unmeasured metabolic enzyme x direct histone enzyme pairs by negative synergistic fitness signal, with explicit single-gene eligibility and resistance evidence
sources: HT29 knockout only for the primary event; CRISPRi and CRISPRa scales are not assigned the same -1 threshold
loss: Mean weighted BCE for dLFC < -1 and auxiliary dLFC < -0.75 heads, plus 0.25 standardized dLFC smooth-L1 and 0.25 positive-negative pairwise logistic ranking loss; sqrt negative/positive class weight capped at 20
xgb_early_stopping: Validation aucpr for classifier; RMSE for auxiliary regressor
selection: Maximum mean pair-holdout validation average precision across 5 seeds; choose best GNN and report unrestricted best model separately
early_stopping: Validation average precision; regression_only uses validation RMSE
calibration: Platt logistic calibration of seed-ensemble logits on untouched calibration set; probability refers to the HT29 screening event, not resistant-cell SL
final_fit: Refit selected GNN with train+test only after fixed-test evaluation; retain validation and calibration; report benchmark ensemble performance separately

candidate_policy.ranking: Single-effect compatibility tier, calibrated synergy probability descending, predicted dLFC ascending, canonical pair key

data_reuse: Existing public data and prior test results were already examined; this is a revised internal experiment, not a new blinded external validation
